sources.title: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B Benchmarks & Speed (August 2026) | BenchLM.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B is a open weight model with a 262K context window. It uses an explicit reasoning mode, which can improve complex problem solving while adding latency and token use.

sources.title: qwen/qwen3.5-122b-a10b — 262K context, $0.40/1M | haimaker.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 122B A10B (qwen/qwen3.5-122b-a10b) is a qwen3_5_moe 125.1B-parameter model from Qwen with a 262,144-token context window and 65,536 max output tokens, priced at $0.40/1M input and $2.00/1M output tokens. Available via the haimaker.ai OpenAI-compatible API.

sources.title: Qwen 3.5 122B A10B — 122B MoE LLM | FitMyLLM
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.5 122B A10B: 122B parameters, 256K context, chat, coding, reasoning, multilingual, vision, math. 20 benchmarks, 17 quantizations. VRAM requirements, speed ...

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B is a mid-tier member of the Qwen3.5 family, sharing the gated delta networks MoE architecture with 122B total parameters and 10B activated per token (256 experts).
